prompt: High-end culinary studio food photography of Vietnamese-style Yang Chow Fried Rice (Cơm chiên Dương Châu). A wide artisanal dark ceramic platter heaped high with fluffy, glistening separate golden grains of fragrant wok-tossed jasmine rice. Vibrant, colorful mosaic toppings throughout: glistening diced red Chinese sausage (lạp xưởng), succulent pink shrimp, golden egg ribbons, tender green peas, diced bright orange carrots, and thinly sliced scallions. Light wok-hei aromatic steam wafting gently. Garnished with fresh sprigs of coriander (ngò rí) and crisp sliced green cucumbers on the side. Accompanied by a small vintage ceramic saucer of dark soy sauce with red bird's eye chili slices. Dark textured rustic wooden tabletop, natural warm directional lighting, crisp appetizing textures, professional 4k food photography.

Authentic Mekong Delta Fermented Fish Hotpot Feast (Lẩu mắm miền Tây). A central bubbling metal hotpot filled with fragrant, savory, deep-brown fermented fish broth simmering with purple eggplant chunks, fresh bird's eye chilies, and lemongrass stalks. Surrounding the pot is an opulent banquet of fresh ingredients: thinly sliced pork belly, snakehead fish fillets (cá lóc), fresh whole river prawns, squid, and an overflowing bamboo platter of delta aquatic vegetables (bông súng, rau đắng, kèo nèo, điên điển). Soft restaurant lighting, appetizing rising steam, rustic wooden table, 4k resolution.

Iconic Southern Crispy Rice with Caramelized Pork Dip (Cơm cháy kho quẹt). A golden, ultra-crispy, paper-thin round disc of scorched rice crust (cơm cháy) broken into crunchy rustic shards on a woven bamboo tray lined with banana leaf. Beside it, a sizzling hot small clay pot of rich, dark amber caramelized fish sauce dip (kho quẹt) packed with crispy pork cracklings (tóp mỡ), sweet dried shrimp, green whole peppercorns, and red bird's eye chilies. Accompanied by a platter of vibrant blanched vegetables (okra, carrot batons, chayote). Dark rustic wood table, cozy and savory, 4k resolution.

Authentic Southern Pork Offal Congee (Cháo lòng miền Nam). A deep stoneware bowl of rich, velvety, brownish pork bone congee seasoned with cooked blood and fragrant spices. Topped with neatly arranged slices of poached pork liver, heart, small intestines, tongue, and crispy slices of fried blood sausage (dồi chiên giòn). Garnished with fresh scallions, cilantro, ginger slivers, freshly ground black pepper, served with a plate of golden fried crullers (quẩy) and chili fish sauce on a rustic wooden table, rising gentle steam, 4k resolution.

Sizzling Vietnamese Steak and Eggs (Bò né trứng ốp la). Sizzling fiercely on a cow-shaped black cast-iron skillet resting on a wooden trivet: tender marinated beef steak slices seared with butter and garlic, two sunny-side-up fried eggs with runny golden yolks, a scoop of creamy pork liver pâté, and pork meatballs. Garnished with fresh cilantro sprigs and thinly sliced red chili, accompanied by a warm crispy Vietnamese baguette, cucumber slices, and sweet-savory soy sauce with black pepper. Sizzling steam and gloss, dark rustic wood table, 4k resolution.

Vietnamese Sweet Snail Stir-fry with Garlic Butter (Ốc hương xào bơ tỏi). A ceramic serving dish loaded with glossy spotted sweet snails (ốc hương) glazed in a golden, fragrant, rich melted butter sauce packed with crispy toasted minced garlic bits and finely chopped red chilies. Garnished with fresh Vietnamese coriander (rau răm) and served with a crusty toasted baguette to dip in the garlic butter sauce and a small saucer of salt, pepper, and kumquat juice. Glistening butter highlights, rustic wooden table, gourmet street seafood style, 4k resolution.

Mekong Delta River Goby Hotpot with Sour Giang Leaves (Lẩu cá kèo lá giang). A bubbling stainless-steel or clay hotpot filled with clear, tangy, aromatic broth simmered with crushed sour river leaves (lá giang) and sliced red chilies. Inside the soup swim fresh, whole sweet river goby fish (cá kèo) with tender flesh. Accompanied by a side platter of fresh banana blossoms, water spinach, fine rice vermicelli, and a bowl of sweet-savory fish sauce dip with bird's eye chilies. Soft warm restaurant lighting, rising aromatic steam, rustic wooden table, 4k resolution.
